logical_pair.scope: Exact dynamics of one local logical Weyl pair inside the large tensor code, using its five-dimensional irreducible representation. This does not measure a lattice wave dispersion.

sector_comparison.scope: Two successive basis absolute-value operations on 75 charged states and independent spectra of all 25 syndrome blocks. The all-volume comparison is proved analytically in the note.

guarded_dynamics.scope: Each local inactive label has eleven identical copies in the full four-spin model; this 216-state block represents every active/inactive pattern. This toy has independent check relations, so its charge lower bound is Delta; the periodic tensor code instead has 2 Delta.

derivative_obstruction.scope: Exact coefficient elimination for analytic continuum-neutral local patterns: X starts at one derivative and Z at two. Modular-only patterns or singular coefficient limits are outside this statement.

cubic_expansion.scope: The formal unwrapped quadratic expansion gives cubic dispersion. This is not a theorem that the fixed five-state quantum model is gapless or has this continuum limit.

scope: Exact nontrivial local dynamics in the compact constraint space with a protected low-energy sector, plus an obstruction to a regular linear-wave expansion with the fixed linear gauges. Einstein gravity and the nonlinear constraint completion remain unproved.
